toegepas.blok: Vlieg is meer as net opstyg
toegepas.voor: kon die vlieënier die neus self draai
toegepas.na: kon die vlieënier self die neus draai
toegepas.rede_vinder: Placing 'self' before the object reads more naturally and matches 'self besluit' in the sentence before.
toegepas.fout: 'die neus self draai' can be misread as 'turn the nose itself' rather than 'the pilot himself turns the nose'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Placing 'self' before the object removes the ambiguity and echoes 'self besluit' in the previous sentence without moving the meaning.

toegepas.voor: Twee broers wat fietse herstel het, het so die lug in 'n pad verander.
toegepas.na: So het twee broers wat fietse herstel het, van die lug 'n pad gemaak.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Van die lug 'n pad maak' is the idiomatic Afrikaans form of this image, and inversion removes the clumsy 'het, het'.
toegepas.fout: 'het, het' collision and the literal 'die lug in 'n pad verander' read stiff at the close of the lesson.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Van die lug 'n pad maak' is the natural Afrikaans form of the image, keeps 'so' and the same people and claim, and touches no protected wording.

vlae.blok: Hul eerste vliegtuig was 'n sweeftuig / Wat 'n enjin verander het
vlae.teks: Dit gly stadig al laer deur die lug om hom. ... Hy moet dus eers hoogte kry voordat hy kan gly.
vlae.rede: The glider is 'dit' in one block and 'hy' in the next, with 'om hom' after 'dit'; both forms are acceptable Afrikaans and the 'dit' and 'om hom' wordings are protected, so nothing is changed, but a person may want one pronoun throughout.

vlae.teks: Daarom kan 'n vliegtuig homself vorentoe stoot in plaas daarvan om af te gly.
vlae.rede: Read alone, 'n vliegtuig' includes a glider (the glossary calls a sweeftuig a vliegtuig), so the sentence relies on 'Daarom' to mean an aeroplane with an engine; making that explicit would add words to the claim, so it is flagged rather than changed.
